verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a model API product, since a model provider could ship downloadable weights or an on-prem deployment. Nothing in the pack shows Gemini can be self-hosted. Every item describes Google-hosted access: API calls with an API key, cloud regional endpoints for data residency, and cloud fine-tuning jobs. None of these is self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
